0022600199.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-7, 13th in the East) visit the Dallas Mavericks (5-4, 10th in the West) as they look to bounce back from a loss, with Brooklyn 1-4 on the road and Dallas 3-2 at home and riding a one-game winning streak. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Mikel Brown Jr. (rest), who is averaging 12.0 points and 22.9 minutes per game this season, while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Nets lost all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 123-114 defeat in Brooklyn on February 24, 2026.
